title: Read my activity
summary: Today's or yesterday's activity from Health (steps, active energy, exercise minutes, distance), read only and only when Health access is already on.
whenToUse: Use when the person asks about their steps, activity, calories burned or exercise minutes.

arguments.name: day
arguments.description: today or yesterday; empty for today

example: How many steps have I taken today?
_note: Phase AV.22 (2026-11-12): the Health applet for the agent, through its own service.
